faqs.question: Does KCVAS offer the agriculture degree covered on other profiles?
faqs.answer: The audited ICAR row explicitly lists B.V.Sc. & A.H. only. No B.Sc. Agriculture accreditation is inferred for KCVAS.

faqs.question: Which university is it affiliated to?
faqs.answer: The college and GADVASU identify affiliation to Guru Angad Dev Veterinary and Animal Sciences University, Ludhiana.

faqs.question: How long is the veterinary programme?
faqs.answer: GADVASU’s undergraduate rules specify 5½ years. This current programme statement is preferred to the college’s older five-year historical description.

faqs.question: Where is the clinical complex?
faqs.answer: The college places it at village Mahal on Ram Tirath Road, about two kilometres from the main campus.

faqs.question: When does the verified ICAR term end?
faqs.answer: The audited term ends on 8 November 2026. A renewal decision after that date must be checked before describing later accreditation.

faqs.question: What tuition does the 2026–27 KCVAS table quote?
faqs.answer: The KCVAS section of the GADVASU 2026–27 prospectus quotes six-monthly tuition of₹1,80,000 for University Quota,₹3,80,000 forManagement Quota and₹4,37,500 forSpecial Management Quota. Other charges, securities and accommodation are separate; this is not an annual or full-degree price.

faqs.question: What entry qualification is published for KCVAS?
faqs.answer: GADVASU’s NEET-UG-2026 rules require 10+2 or equivalent with Physics, Chemistry, Biology and English and 50% aggregate excluding optional subjects (47.5% for SC/ST, BC and DP categories), plus the relevant NEET cutoff. Category, domicile and quota conditions also apply.

faqs.question: Which named academic staff are listed for KCVAS?
faqs.answer: The Veterinary Clinical Complex page provides named staff and roles; these are the public listings checked on 30 October 2026. Dr. P. S. Mavi — Professor, Veterinary Clinical Complex; Dr. Rajvinder Grover — Assistant Professor, Veterinary Clinical Complex.

faqs.question: Which scholarship or support information is published for KCVAS?
faqs.answer: The 2026–27 GADVASU prospectus states that KCVAS students eligible for the Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme and admitted in the SC/ST university-quota category are charged the same fee as eligible GADVASU students. This is a restricted category rule, not a scholarship promise for management, NRI or every veterinary student. Prospectus section 2.2.5.2(iii) limits the rule to eligible SC/ST students under University Quota. Confirm current government eligibility, documents, reimbursement processing and the payable statement for your individual offer.

faqs.question: Which application documents are listed for KCVAS?
faqs.answer: NEET-UG 2026 result/score evidence for the applicable Indian-national admission category; Original academic certificates and relevant quota/category certificates as specified in the 2026–27 prospectus. Match these to the official requirements for your chosen programme and quota.
